Slows Special trigger (cooldown count+1).

special.d: When healing an ally with a staff, restores an additional 10 HP to target ally.
When healing an ally with a staff, grants Def+4 to all allies for 1 turn.
When healing an ally with a staff, grants Atk/Def+4 to all allies for 1 turn.
When healing an ally with a staff, grants Atk/Def+6 to all allies for 1 turn.

b.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, foe cannot counterattack.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, foe cannot counterattack.

c.d: While unit lives and uses a staff, unit gets 1.5x EXP. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)
While unit lives, all staff allies on team get 1.5x EXP. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)
While unit lives, all staff allies on team get 2x EXP. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)
